# Gatekeeper Headlamp Plugin

This plugin integrates Gatekeeper with Headlamp, providing a UI for policies,
mutations, configuration, external data, violation export, expansion templates,
and the Gatekeeper Policy Library.

## Features

- Browse ConstraintTemplates, dynamically discovered Constraints, and violations
- View Assign, AssignMetadata, AssignImage, and ModifySet mutation resources
- Inspect Config, SyncSet, Provider, Connection, and ExpansionTemplate resources
- Review Gatekeeper controller status and delete supported resources
- Preview and apply policies from the Gatekeeper Policy Library
install:
Desktop Headlamp
- Install Headlamp (https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/desktop/)
- Open Plugin Catalog
- Clear the Official filter if enabled; this plugin is verified but not marked official
- Select the Gatekeeper plugin and click the install button
- After install you may need to restart Headlamp
